newsitem.title: UK: Spice girl Adams to marry England footballer - paper.
newsitem.headline: Spice girl Adams to marry England footballer - paper.

text.p: Spice Girl Victoria Adams is to marry an English international footballer, a British newspaper reported on Sunday in an article accompanied by a picture of the pop star emerging from a wedding dress shop.
The Sunday Mirror named the groom-to-be as David Beckham, the Manchester United player who on Saturday helped his country to a 2-0 victory over Poland.
Beckham parked his BMW car in the drive of the Adams' family home in Goff's Oak, north of London, before the match, the paper said.
Neither Beckham nor singer Adams, known as Posh Spice, was quoted in the article, which also did not name the day for wedding bells to ring out.
Adams' mother Jackie told the Mirror: "David would be welcomed into our family."
"He is is such a decent guy, I couldn't ask more for my daughter. There's been a lot of speculation about Victoria and David, but the future is up to them."
